clips.title: The story
paras: High Executor Hadrec dispatches Horde adventurers into Shadowfang Keep to locate two missing reconnaissance agents, Deathstalker Adamant and Deathstalker Vincent. The Forsaken military relies on their gathered intelligence to coordinate an assault against Archmage Arugal and his worgen packs. Breaching the fortress reveals the grim reality of espionage behind enemy lines.

Silverpine Forest remains contested ground, with Archmage Arugal's feral worgen holding the towering redoubt of Shadowfang Keep. Seeking to break this siege on their southern borders, the Forsaken command stationed at the Sepulcher organized an intelligence operation. High Executor Hadrec sent two seasoned Deathstalkers—Adamant and Vincent—to infiltrate the fortress and chart its defenses. When days passed without word, Hadrec grew desperate for their field reports, tasking capable Horde champions with entering the stronghold to recover the agents and salvage the mission.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: In preparation for an assault on Shadowfang, two deathstalkers were sent to the keep to gather intelligence. It has been many days and they have not returned, but we must receive their report if we're to have any hope of a successful attack!
So here is your task, friend. Go to Shadowfang Keep to the south and find the Deathstalkers Adamant and Vincent. Find them, and if they require aid then give it.
This mission is as dangerous as is it critical, friend. Do not fail.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Vincent's body lies broken, and still.
Although Deathstalker Adamant will send his report to Hadrec... Whatever additional details Vincent gained must remain with him.
But clutched in his hand is a small trinket...
